subject.title: Feature Request: Slack-Style @Mention Autocomplete in Control UI Chat

question: Should Control UI add `@agent` autocomplete as a dedicated feature now, or should it wait for a shared composer suggestion contract that also covers custom terms?
rationale: This is a new UX/API surface, not a broken existing contract, and the proposed new RPC overlaps with the existing `agents.list` metadata contract while related custom-term autocomplete remains open.

options.title: Design Shared Composer Suggestions
options.body: Define a reusable suggestion/chip contract first, then implement agent mentions and leave room for custom-term suggestions without parallel UI models.

options.title: Ship Agent Mentions Only
options.body: Implement `@agent` autocomplete now by reusing `agents.list`, accepting a narrower first step and tracking custom-term support separately.

options.title: Defer Until Demand Is Clearer
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not implement until maintainers prioritize WebChat composition ergonomics over current stability/setup work.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Composer Suggestions
recommendation.body: Define a reusable suggestion/chip contract first, then implement agent mentions and leave room for custom-term suggestions without parallel UI models.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is the strongest routing candidate from the slash-command UX history and the adjacent custom-term autocomplete discussion.
